defaults.source_citation: Generic class value representative of open-literature ranges; not derived from any specific system (docs/db/data-dictionary.md#generic-values)

provenance.source_citation: Generic estimate (docs/db/data-dictionary.md#generic-values): a medium-calibre gun reaches aircraft at about half its surface range (fire control and time of flight against a manoeuvring target); for comparison, open sources give 3 km for the Oerlikon 35 mm KCB and 4 km for the Bofors 40 mm L/70 against air targets. Gate 4 finding 2, for SME review

Generic estimate (docs/db/data-dictionary.md#generic-values): a medium-calibre gun reaches aircraft at about half its surface range (fire control and time of flight against a manoeuvring target); for comparison, open sources give 3 km for the Oerlikon 35 mm KCB and 4 km for the Bofors 40 mm L/70 against air targets. Wikipedia, "SSM-700K C-Star", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SSM-700K_C-Star (accessed 2026-11-13): Mach 0.95, 250 kg warhead, GPS/INS and active radar; range 150 km (body text; the infobox gives >180 km); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "YJ-83", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YJ-83 (accessed 2026-11-13): 180 km, Mach 0.9 cruise (Mach 1.4 terminal not modelled), 190 kg HE-frag warhead, INS and active radar; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "YJ-18", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YJ-18 (accessed 2026-11-13): 180 km cruise at Mach 0.8 plus 40 km sprint at Mach 2.5-3 (220 km total; the sprint is not modelled), 300 kg warhead per Chinese media claims; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "HQ-16", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HQ-16 (accessed 2026-11-13): 40 km slant range (HQ-16/16A), semi-active radar homing; speed and warhead not given (generic medium-range SAM values); base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-MR model value
Wikipedia, "HQ-9", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HQ-9 (accessed 2026-11-13): 120 km (HQ-9), Mach 4.2, 180 kg warhead; naval figures not separately given; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-LR model value

Wikipedia, "Mistral (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mistral_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): 8 km (Mistral 3), 930 m/s, 2.95 kg warhead, IR homing; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-PD model value

Wikipedia, "MICA (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MICA_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): vertical launch 20 km, Mach 4, 12 kg warhead; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-SR model value

Wikipedia, "Spike (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spike_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): NLOS 0.6-32 km, imaging IR with fibre/radio datalink; speed and warhead not given (generic light anti-ship values); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-LIGHT model value

Wikipedia, "Harpoon (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpoon_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): ship-launched Block I >143 km, 240 m/s, 221 kg warhead, active radar terminal homing (air-launched range longer; the shorter figure is used); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "RIM-66 Standard", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RIM-66_Standard (accessed 2026-11-13): family range 74-170 km (the lower bound is used), Mach 3.5, semi-active radar homing, usable against ships; warhead mass not given (generic); base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-MR model value

Wikipedia, "AGM-123 Skipper II", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AGM-123_Skipper_II (accessed 2026-11-13): 25 km, 1,100 km/h, Mk 83 1,000 lb (450 kg) warhead, laser guidance; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-LIGHT model value

Wikipedia, "Sea Killer / Marte", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sea_Killer_/_Marte (accessed 2026-11-13): Mk 2 over 25 km, Mach 0.8-0.9, 70 kg SAP warhead, beam riding; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-LIGHT model value

Wikipedia, "Limbo (weapon)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Limbo_(weapon) (accessed 2026-11-13): 366-914 m, 94 kg Minol, sonar-directed (Type 170); sink rate generic; base Ph is the generic WPN-DEPTH-CHARGE model value

Wikipedia, "Kh-35", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kh-35 (accessed 2026-11-13): 130 km, Mach 0.8-0.85 (0.8 used), 145 kg HE-fragmentation warhead, inertial and active radar homing; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Kalibr (missile family)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalibr_(missile_family) (accessed 2026-11-13): 3M54E export anti-ship version 220 km, Mach 0.8 (the supersonic terminal stage is not modelled), 400-500 kg warhead (400 used), inertial and active radar homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUBLAUNCH model value

Wikipedia, "RIM-66 Standard", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RIM-66_Standard (accessed 2026-11-13): 40-92 nmi (the SM-2MR upper figure, 170 km, used), Mach 3.5, command and inertial midcourse with semi-active terminal homing; warhead mass not given (generic); base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-MR model value

Wikipedia, "RIM-174 Standard ERAM", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RIM-174_Standard_ERAM (accessed 2026-11-13): 130 nmi (240 km; longer ranges quoted are not used), Mach 3.5, 140 lb (64 kg) blast-fragmentation warhead, inertial with active and semi-active terminal homing, anti-ship capable; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-LR model value

Wikipedia, "RIM-162 ESSM", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RIM-162_ESSM (accessed 2026-11-13): 50 km+, Mach 4+, 39 kg blast-fragmentation warhead, quad-packed in Mk 41 cells; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-SR model value

Wikipedia, "Naval Strike Missile", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naval_Strike_Missile (accessed 2026-11-13): >200 km quoted for NSM (185 km used, the long-standing figure, pending SME review), Mach 0.93, 120 kg warhead, GPS-aided INS with imaging infrared terminal homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Mark 48 torpedo", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_48_torpedo (accessed 2026-11-13): 38 km at 55 kn (estimated; officially greater than 5 mi), 647 lb (293 kg) warhead; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-HW model value

Wikipedia, "Mark 54 lightweight torpedo", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_54_lightweight_torpedo (accessed 2026-11-13): 10,000 yd (9.1 km), >40 kn, 96.8 lb (44 kg) PBXN-103, active or passive/active acoustic homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-LW model value

Wikipedia, "RIM-116 Rolling Airframe Missile", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RIM-116_Rolling_Airframe_Missile (accessed 2026-11-13): 9 km, in excess of Mach 2, 11.3 kg warhead; SeaRAM is an 11-cell launcher; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-PD model value

Wikipedia, "Type 90 ship-to-ship missile", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Type_90_ship-to-ship_missile (accessed 2026-11-13): 150-200 km (150 used), 1,150 km/h, 260 kg warhead, inertial and active radar homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Type 12 surface-to-ship missile", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Type_12_surface-to-ship_missile (accessed 2026-11-13): the Type 17 is the ship-launched member of the family, 400 km, inertial, GPS and Ka-band AESA radar homing; speed and warhead not given (generic anti-ship values); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Type 89 torpedo", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Type_89_torpedo (accessed 2026-11-13): 27 nmi (50 km) at 40 kn, 21 nmi at 55 kn (55 kn used for speed), 267 kg warhead, wire-guided with active and passive homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-HW model value

Wikipedia, "Harpoon (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harpoon_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): ship-launched Block II greater than 67 nmi (124 km; air-launched range longer, the shorter figure is used), greater than 537 mph (240 m/s), 488 lb (221 kg) warhead; minimum range as Block I; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "AGM-114 Hellfire", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AGM-114_Hellfire (accessed 2026-11-13): 0.5-11 km, Mach 1.3; warhead mass not given in the infobox (generic light anti-ship value); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-LIGHT model value

Wikipedia, "9K38 Igla", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/9K38_Igla (accessed 2026-11-13): 5.2 km (Igla), 570 m/s peak, 1.17 kg warhead, infrared homing; the Igla-M fitted to Vietnamese ships is modelled by it; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-PD model value

Wikipedia, "Exocet", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exocet (accessed 2026-11-13): 72 km for the Block 2, Mach 0.93, 165 kg warhead, inertial and active radar homing; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Exocet", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exocet (accessed 2026-11-13): Block 3 '200 km class', Mach 0.93, 165 kg warhead, inertial, GPS and active radar homing; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

Wikipedia, "Exocet", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exocet (accessed 2026-11-13): SM39 submarine-launched 50 km, Mach 0.93, 165 kg warhead; minimum range a generic value; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUBLAUNCH model value

Wikipedia, "Sea Wolf (missile)", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sea_Wolf_(missile) (accessed 2026-11-13): VLS 1-10 km, Mach 3, 14 kg HE blast-fragmentation, automatic command to line of sight; base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-PD model value

Wikipedia, "Black Shark torpedo", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Shark_torpedo (accessed 2026-11-13): 50 km, 50 kn (unclassified figure), 350 kg warhead; guidance generic for a wire-guided heavyweight; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-HW model value

Wikipedia, "Hsiung Feng II", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hsiung_Feng_II (accessed 2026-11-13): 160 km (Block 1), 1,041 km/h, 180 kg warhead, inertial midcourse with active radar and infrared terminal seekers (infrared not modelled); base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

weapons.name: Hsiung Feng III supersonic anti-ship missile

provenance.source_citation: Wikipedia, "Hsiung Feng III", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hsiung_Feng_III (accessed 2026-11-13): >100 km (100 used), about Mach 3.5 (1,200 m/s), 225 kg self-forging fragment warhead, inertial and X-band active radar homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASM-SUB model value

weapons.name: TC-2N naval surface-to-air missile (Sky Sword II)

provenance.source_citation: Wikipedia, "Sky Sword II", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sky_Sword_II (accessed 2026-11-13): in the naval role the TC-2N fills the gap between Phalanx and SM-2 with a range of 30 km; speed, warhead and seeker for the naval version not given (generic short-range SAM values; active radar assumed); base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-SR model value

Wikipedia, "K-SAAM", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K-SAAM (accessed 2026-11-13): 20 km, Mach 2, fire-and-forget infrared homing; warhead not given (generic short-range SAM value); base Ph is the generic WPN-SAM-SR model value

Wikipedia, "K745 Blue Shark", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K745_Blue_Shark (accessed 2026-11-13): 19 km, 45+ kn, acoustic homing, 280 kg weight; warhead not given (generic lightweight torpedo value); base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-LW model value

Wikipedia, "K745A1 Red Shark", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K745A1_Red_Shark (accessed 2026-11-13): 12 mi (19.3 km), carries a K745 Blue Shark torpedo dropped by parachute near the target; flight speed and warhead generic; base Ph is the generic WPN-ASW-ROCKET model value

Wikipedia, "MU90 Impact", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MU90_Impact (accessed 2026-11-13): >10 km at maximum speed (>23 km at minimum speed), 29 to well over 50 kn (50 used), 32.7 kg shaped-charge warhead, active or passive acoustic homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-LW model value

Wikipedia, "A244 torpedo", https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A244_torpedo (accessed 2026-11-13): 13.5 km, 30-39 kn (39 used), 45.4 kg warhead, active/passive acoustic homing; base Ph is the generic WPN-TORP-LW model value
